title: Asked
note: Renata's day at Pia's field hospital. Two failed DC 14 medical checks (rolled 10, then 9). Pia's hand on hers uninvited. Renata sets the consent terms ('Stop touching unless I ask') but then does the thing her training has been keeping her from doing: asks Pia to lead. The vessel closes. The patient lives. Four hours of work in the hospital with her mouth different than it had been. None of the patients she touched died. That was new.
